# `adt atc`

Run ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC) checks

```bash
adt atc [options]
```

**Options**

| Option                        | Description                                                            | Default   |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `-p, --package <package>`     | Run ATC on package                                                     |           |
| `-o, --object <uri>`          | Run ATC on specific object (e.g., /sap/bc/adt/oo/classes/zcl_my_class) |           |
| `-t, --transport <transport>` | Run ATC on transport request (e.g., TRLK942970)                        |           |
| `-f, --from-file <file>`      | Run ATC on objects listed in file (one URI per line)                   |           |
| `--variant <variant>`         | ATC check variant (default: from system customizing)                   |           |
| `--max-results <number>`      | Maximum number of results                                              | `100`     |
| `--format <format>`           | Output format: console, json, gitlab, sarif                            | `console` |
| `--output <file>`             | Output file (required for gitlab/sarif format)                         |           |
| `--resolver <name>`           | Finding resolver plugin for path/line resolution (e.g., abapgit)       |           |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
